prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat pyproject.toml && (mypy src/ 2>&1 | tail -50) && find src -name '*.py' | head -50
cat -n src/trailhead/elevation.py && echo ---- && sed -n 25,55p src/trailhead/pace.py && echo ---- && sed -n 25,55p src/trailhead/report.py
cat -n src/trailhead/track.py && echo ---- && ls tests && grep -rn "ele" tests | head -40 && grep -rn "ele\b" src | grep -v "elevation.py" | head -30
cat tests/test_elevation.py && ls && grep -rniE "missing|blank|empty|lost|none|gap" README* docs 2>/dev/null | head -20; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; git log --oneline | head

mypy 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "--- pytest"; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "--- ruff"; (ruff check src tests 2>&1 || true) | tail -5; echo "--- None-ele sanity"; PYTHONPATH=src python -c "
from trailhead.track import parse_track
from trailhead.elevation import highest_and_lowest, steepest_grade, gain_and_loss
from trailhead.report import summarise
t = parse_track('lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,160\n')
print(t.elevations(), highest_and_lowest(t), steepest_grade(t), gain_and_loss(t.elevations()))
print(summarise(t))
try:
    parse_track('lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n').elevations()
except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__, e)
"; git -C . status --short
